bluetooth: skip registration of SuspendManager in Power manager Some boards, i.e., minnie, mickey, and speedy, suffer from a spurious BT wake issue by gpio-key due to HCI events sent when system is going to suspend. To work around the issue, the registration of SuspendManager is skipped such that no HCI commands are sent before system suspension. BUG=chromium:953860 TEST=Conduct suspend test on two kinds of boards - mickey, minnie, or speedy - boards other than above, e.g., eve Do system suspension and observe that there is no spurious BT wake. $ date; powerd_dbus_suspend --wakeup_timeout=60; date Cq-Depend: chromium:1617184, chrome-internal:1311353, chrome-internal:1313874, chrome-internal:1313875 Change-Id: I0e88f8055ec29dce68f0d9ebd461da18f76f7cb6 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1605185 Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Tested-by: Shyh-In Hwang <josephsih@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sonny Sasaka <sonnysasaka@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Shyh-In Hwang <josephsih@chromium.org>
